Druidic                                                    (Perception) check but can’t decipher it without

You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You
can speak the language and use it to leave hidden          Spellcasting
messages. You and others who know this language
automatically spot such a message. Others spot the         Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you
message’s presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom          can cast spells to shape that essence to your will.
